title: Integrated and Cross-Architecture Interpretation of LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2605.28006v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Understanding how LLMs reason is hindered by a practical asymmetry: while their generated outputs are observable, the underlying reasoning patterns remain opaque. Relying on single probes, such as Mutual Information Peak (MIP) or Deep-Thinking Ratio (DTR), risks underestimating the genuine inferential structure. To response this deficiency, we present an Integrated, cross-Architecture Reasoning (IAR) framework, designed to provide a unified approach to LLM reasoning interpretability. Specifically, we first propose to use bandwidth-calibrated MIP coupled with Tukey IQR peak-detection to isolate reasoning-crucial tokens at the output layer. Second, we performed an overlap analysis between MIP-picked tokens and DTR-deep tokens to trace the cross-layer trajectories of those tokens. This also discloses whether reasoning-crucial tokens are computation-intensive as well, further facilitating to understand how reasoning patterns evolve

translated_title: 大语言模型推理的集成化跨架构解释
translated_abstract: 理解大语言模型（LLM）如何进行推理一直受到一个实际不对称性的阻碍：虽然其生成的输出是可观察的，但底层的推理模式仍然是不透明的。仅依赖单一探测手段（如互信息峰值 MIP 或深度思考比率 DTR）可能会低估真实的推理结构。为应对这一不足，我们提出了一个集成化跨架构推理框架，旨在为 LLM 推理可解释性提供统一的方法。具体而言，我们首先提出使用带宽校准的 MIP 结合 Tukey IQR 峰值检测，在输出层分离出对推理至关重要的词元。其次，我们对 MIP 选出的词元与 DTR 深度词元进行重叠分析，以追踪这些词元的跨层轨迹。这也揭示了推理关键词元是否同时也是计算密集型的，从而进一步有助于理解推理模式如何演化。
tldr: 提出集成化跨架构推理（IAR）框架，通过带宽校准的MIP结合Tukey IQR峰值检测定位输出层的推理关键词元，并与DTR深度词元进行重叠分析以追踪其跨层轨迹，为LLM推理可解释性提供了统一方法。
en_tdlr: Proposes an Integrated cross-Architecture Reasoning (IAR) framework that combines bandwidth-calibrated MIP with Tukey IQR peak detection to isolate reasoning-crucial tokens at the output layer, and traces their cross-layer trajectories via overlap analysis with DTR-deep tokens, providing a unified approach to LLM reasoning interpretability.
